## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSWOTDiagram> CreateSWOTDiagramElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSWOTDiagram> CreateSWOTDiagramElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, SWOTDesign design);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSWOTDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

|---|---|---|
| `onItemSelect` | `std::function<void(SWOTQuadrant, size_t, const SWOTItem&)> onItemSelect` | _Item select_ |

| `onItemDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(SWOTQuadrant, size_t, const SWOTItem&)> onItemDoubleClick` | _Item double click_ |
| `onSelectionChange` | `std::function<void()> onSelectionChange` | _Selection change_ |

## Option types in this header

### enum `SWOTQuadrant`

The four SWOT quadrants in canonical order: Strengths / Weaknesses (internal), Opportunities / Threats (external)

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Strengths = 0` |  |
| `Weaknesses = 1` |  |
| `Opportunities = 2` |  |
| `Threats = 3` |  |

### enum `SWOTDesign`

Geometry presets. All designs render the same four item lists; they only change how the panels are arranged and decorated.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Matrix` | Classic contiguous 2x2 grid (optional axis captions) |
| `Cards` | Four separated rounded cards with colored header bars |
| `CornerBadges` | Vivid filled panels, letter badges at the outer |
| `CenterDiamond` | corners and a central "SWOT analysis" circle Central rotated square of four letter triangles with |
| `Rows` | text blocks at the surrounding corners Four stacked horizontal bands with big letter blocks |
| `Columns` | Four side-by-side columns with header chips |

Identifies one item for hit testing / selection (quadrant + item index). item < 0 means "no item".

| `quadrant` | `int quadrant = -1` |  |
| `item` | `int item = -1` |  |
